   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%ner%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count,
  ts_rank_cd(
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.abstract, '')), 'B'),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'acl') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'sound') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'machine') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'stylistic') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'marina') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'del') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'rey') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'hospital')
  ) AS rank
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  p.canonical_venue = 'ACL'
  AND (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')) @@
      (plainto_tsquery('english', 'sound') ||
       plainto_tsquery('english', 'machine') ||
       plainto_tsquery('english', 'stylistic') ||
       plainto_tsquery('english', 'marina') ||
       plainto_tsquery('english', 'del') ||
       plainto_tsquery('english', 'rey') ||
       plainto_tsquery('english', 'hospital'))
    OR
    p.title ILIKE '%sound%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%machine%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%stylistic%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%marina del rey%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%hospital%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%sound%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%machine%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%stylistic%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%marina del rey%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%hospital%'
  )

  p.title,

LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id

- corpus_id (INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY → Papers.corpus_id): Reference to paper
- author_id (VARCHAR, FOREIGN KEY → Authors.author_id): Reference to author
- author_position (INTEGER): Author position (0 = first author)

Table: Institutions

- display_name (TEXT): Institution name

- country_code (VARCHAR): ISO country code (e.g., 'US', 'CN', 'GB')
- institution_type (VARCHAR): Type (e.g., 'education', 'government', 'nonprofit')

Table: AuthorInstitutions (Junction table for many-to-many relationship)

- PRIMARY KEY: (author_id, institution_id)

RELATIONSHIPS:
- Papers ←→ Authors (many-to-many through PaperAuthors)
- Authors ←→ Institutions (many-to-many through AuthorInstitutions)
